description:
Cut the next unused Theseus patch release (expected v0.2.9; confirm with `gh release list` and `git ls-remote --tags`) from main once all three release-A items have merged. Follow the repository's release procedure exactly as v0.2.8 did (release PR #57: pyproject.toml, uv.lock, PROVENANCE.md frozen source hash; annotated tag; wheel, retained wheel, sdist, SHA256SUMS).
Release A must NOT change the verdict body or thread format (the writer change is release B); it gives consumers one release in which readers accept both formats.
Guardrails: release PR goes through hosted SHIP + green required checks (independent review only if it touches workflows, policy or lock); no owner-only actions; no live model calls.
